title: Named reactions and combo recipes
hook: **Vision — not playable yet:** a short **learnable** list of named reactions and combo recipes on top of the [element ring](element-ring) — the wet-and-lightning shape — not a second ring and no new elements.

blindSpots.meaning: Design locked, not in the current loop. You cannot study a finished named-recipe catalog as live play yet.

What this is **not**. Recipes sit on the existing six-plus-omni ring.
Interactive battles already talk about windows to react; this page is the shared catalog you can memorize.
A short plan players can learn — wet then lightning style — not a secret wiki table.

alsoTrue: The ring, shields, and statuses already ship — play those.

doTitle: What you do with this page
doSteps: Read it as Vision — not a missing button bug.
